reference.role: art language, not literal gameplay dimensions

bounded_repairs.symptom: Smooth broad pressure shell and repeated rectangular lower staves read as oversimplified boiler forms.
bounded_repairs.change: Closed curved forged platework with fasteners, authored matte pigment and geometry-bound short-range vertex occlusion.

bounded_repairs.symptom: Side service construction remains minimal compared with the selected supplied furnace.
bounded_repairs.change: Grounded framed service hatch, cross strap, hardware, shut-off wheel, gauge markings and pipe unions.

bounded_repairs.symptom: Separated narrow flame spires read as candle-like spikes inside the existing visible firebox.
bounded_repairs.change: Wider curved flame volumes, warm cores, contiguous ember bed and layered firebox reveal.
